extensions.rationale: Abbreviation definition-looking text remains paragraph text; HTML is not expanded.
Ordinary quote with literal [!TIP]; no alert node.
Escaped symbols contribute @ ! <x> as text; generated angles do not initiate HTML.
Disabled narrow switch is superseded by enabled all_symbols_escapable: escaped angles still contribute literal text.
No automatic heading ID is generated, ASCII transliteration does not run.
Heading has no implicit ID.
Bare absolute URI remains text, not link.
Tested triple backticks adjacent to prose are recognized; payload is protected.
Without a blank line, greater-than line continues prose rather than starting a quote.
ATX-looking line without preceding blank continues prose.
Bracketed text becomes span; both raw IDs retained; two effective.
Citation control is protected; no bibliography or citeproc lookup.
Bird is term; winged animal is definition.
Physical line break remains soft break; no East Asian deletion.
Colon name remains text, no emoji expansion.
Backslash plus physical LF is one hard break between a and b.
Example bird receives first example number; reference keeps original (@bird) source.
Lower Roman marker iv. starts ordered list at four; retain nondecimal spelling.
First class python is language; raw IDs one and two retained; two effective.
Blank-document tilde fence with bare text language protects payload.
Fenced division has Markdown child and effective ID two.
Eligible body reference binds exact label a.
Modern item continuation uses two-column marker content indentation, not forced four spaces.
No GFM automatic slug is generated.
Grid-looking layout is ordinary body content, not a grid table.
Reader retains strong/emphasis structure; plain-writer Gutenberg conventions have no reader effect.
Unmarked physical LF is soft, not hard.
Explicit raw heading IDs retained; two effective; no automatic ID.
Unmarked physical LF is retained as soft break, not deleted.
Standalone image remains image paragraph, no figure promotion.
No explicit definition exists: heading does not create shortcut target.
Inline code attributes retain both IDs and select two.
Anonymous inline note owns small note content; no movable named definition.
Both intraword underscores remain text; no emphasis.
Raw macro definition retained; math payload still \bird, never expanded.
Two line-block lines preserve their explicit line separation.
Link explicit ID is two; both occurrences retained.
Bullet-looking continuation without blank does not interrupt paragraph.
Greater-than starts an ordinary quote, not Bird-style Haskell code.
Equals delimiters remain literal, no highlighted span.
Markdown child remains eligible without markdown=1; disabled switch does not restrict enabled markdown_in_html_blocks.
Physical div exposes Markdown child emphasis without markdown attribute.
Square bracket suffix is heading content, not explicit ID.
MultiMarkdown width assignment is not recognized as a link attribute; ordinary reference syntax/fallback applies.
Title and Author are body prose, no metadata.
Spaced multiline layout stays body syntax, no multiline table.
Native Div retains physical opening/closing origin and ordinary child.
Native Span retains both physical tags and lintable child.
Smart is also disabled; dash bytes stay unchanged.
Percent title lines remain body paragraph; no metadata.
Delimiter width two pads short body and truncates semantic excess header/body while retaining all raw fields.
Raw-format fence protects exact latex payload; no missing-language inference.
Physical b tags remain raw/protected; bird remains ordinary inline content.
Recognized TeX environment remains protected, with original pipe.
Relative destination remains ../nest.md without rebasing.
Unclosed short forms remain text, no sub/superscript.
Shortcut bird resolves to the explicit /nest definition.
Space-delimited layout remains body syntax; not a pipe table.
Quote/dot/dash punctuation preserved without smart substitutions.
Space after hash permits ATX heading.
Spaced components do not combine: bird stays literal, r independently resolves as shortcut.
Decimal ordered list starts at seven, retaining original marker.
Paired double tildes surround lintable old text.
Delimited 2 is subscript.
Delimited 2 is superscript.
Caption attributes attach to table; raw IDs retained, two effective.
Attached Table caption extends table through Birds.
Original X/x/space spellings remain; first two checked, last unchecked.
Dollar-delimited inline and display math protect original pipe payloads.
Double-backslash delimiters do not create math; ordinary escape interpretation applies.
Single-backslash parentheses follow punctuation escape semantics, no math.
Wiki brackets/pipe remain text without wiki target/title interpretation.
Wiki brackets/pipe remain text without wiki title/target interpretation.
Both start and mid-document YAML-looking bytes use thematic-break and setext-heading body semantics; no metadata.
